scope: Outcome-blind sequential evaluation of the resource-heavy task in frozen Terminal-Bench Pro Wave 3

checkpoint_design.selection_rule: Evaluate every Wave 3 task; split execution only by declared sandbox resources.
checkpoint_design.evaluation_role: Sealed later-wave evaluation of policy families frozen on Waves 1 and 2
checkpoint_design.revision_reason: This task declares 4 CPUs and 8 GiB, so all four model trials run sequentially.

frozen_policy.policy_change_rule: Do not change routes, ordering, features, margins, or evaluation logic until all Wave 3 outcomes are finalized.

effective_limits.wall_timeout_clock: absolute Unix wall time; includes laptop sleep

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: four sequential Harbor trials followed by a zero-sandbox cleanup check

interpretation_guard: Evaluate all 18 Wave 3 tasks before changing the frozen policies. Recover only non-learning-valid execution failures route-for-route. Report Wave 3 separately before pooling with development data.
